steps.en: OCMS receives the Generate Work Order request
steps.id: OCMS menerima permintaan Generate Work Order
steps.why_en: No Generate Work Order button or request exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Tombol dan permintaan Generate Work Order tidak ada di sistem.

steps.why_en: Only a scheduled DataHive lookup exists, off in prod; ICA/DOS is not confirmed in the code.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada lookup DataHive terjadwal yang mati di prod; ICA/DOS tidak terkonfirmasi di code.

steps.en: Vehicle numbers are sent to DOS
steps.why_en: No code sends vehicle numbers to any agency to find addresses; DOS is not confirmed.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang mengirim vehicle number ke agensi untuk cari alamat; DOS tidak terkonfirmasi.

steps.en: Latest registered address and update date are received
steps.id: Alamat terdaftar terbaru dan tanggal update diterima
steps.why_en: Addresses are saved from a scheduled batch; the agency's update date is not kept.
steps.why_id: Alamat disimpan dari batch terjadwal; tanggal update dari agensi tidak disimpan.

steps.en: Results appear as an on-screen listing
steps.id: Hasil muncul sebagai listing di layar
steps.why_en: No screen lists the address results; they are only stored in the background.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar yang menampilkan hasil alamat; hanya disimpan di belakang layar.
